project.name: Bitwarden Server
project.description: Open-source password manager with zero-knowledge architecture, providing secure credential storage, sync, and sharing across devices

encryption: Zero-knowledge architecture - server never has plaintext access
organization_features: Role-based access control (Owner, Admin, Manager, User)
sync_and_access: Real-time sync across browser extensions, desktop, mobile

cases.paragraph: Bitwarden Server: Open-source password manager with zero-knowledge architecture, providing secure credential storage, sync, and sharing across devices. Main parts: authentication, encryption, vault management, organization features, sync and access. Features: Email/password authentication with master password; Two-factor authentication (TOTP, WebAuthn/FIDO2, Email, Duo); Biometric unlock (fingerprint, face recognition); Password hint recovery; Account recovery via emergency access; Zero-knowledge architecture - server never has plaintext access; AES-256-CBC for vault encryption; PBKDF2-SHA256 for key derivation (600,000 iterations); RSA-2048 for asymmetric operations; Encrypted key exchange for sharing.

project.description: Complete DevOps platform providing Git repository management, CI/CD pipelines, issue tracking, and project management

cases.paragraph: GitLab: Complete DevOps platform providing Git repository management, CI/CD pipelines, issue tracking, and project management. Main parts: repository management, ci cd, access control, collaboration, security features. Features: Git repository hosting; Branch protection rules; Merge request workflows; Code review and approvals; Repository mirroring; Pipeline execution with YAML configuration; Runner management (shared, specific); Environment variables and secrets; Deployment to environments; Artifact storage; Role-based access (Owner, Maintainer, Developer, Reporter, Guest); Group and project level permissions; Protected branches and tags.

project.name: Mastodon
project.description: Decentralized social network based on ActivityPub federation protocol

cases.paragraph: Mastodon: Decentralized social network based on ActivityPub federation protocol. Main parts: social features, media handling, federation, privacy controls, moderation. Features: Status/post creation (toots); Follow/unfollow users; Direct messages; Reblogs and favorites; Lists and hashtags; Image upload with processing; Video upload with transcoding; Audio attachment support; Custom emoji upload; Media descriptions (alt text); ActivityPub protocol support; Remote user follows; Federated timeline; Instance blocklist/allowlist; Signature verification; Post visibility (public, unlisted, followers-only, direct); Account privacy settings.

cases.paragraph: Mattermost: Open-source team collaboration platform for secure messaging, file sharing, and integrations. Main parts: messaging, team management, file sharing, integrations, authentication. Features: Direct messages; Public and private channels; Threaded conversations; Message editing and deletion; Emoji reactions; Team creation and membership; Channel organization; Role-based permissions; Guest accounts; System admin controls; File upload in messages; Image preview generation; File search; Export functionality; Webhook support; Slash commands; Bot accounts; OAuth apps; Plugin system.
